nodes.label: HK
nodes.note: Universal neural model platform: container + runtime + research + tooling on one foundation.

nodes.label: Container (.hk format)
nodes.note: Universal model representation.

nodes.label: Runtime (inference)
nodes.note: Fast memory-efficient inference; today CPU + Vulkan on Linux, 3 architecture families.

nodes.label: Research stack
nodes.note: Quantization, sparsity, growth, lineage, self-training. Python prototypes, small-model tests only.

nodes.label: Tooling
nodes.note: Conversion, serving, SDKs, benchmarks, packaging.

nodes.label: Header / TOC / metadata / reader / writer
nodes.note: 128-byte header, aligned payloads, v1. Reader bounds hardening is uncommitted. arrays.zig holds compact in-place array values for metadata (e.g. 150k-token vocabularies).

nodes.label: Whole-file SHA-256 seal + CRC-32 records
nodes.note: Uncommitted. Re-hashes whole file per mutation (O(file) time). No signatures.

nodes.label: Metadata edit journal / hk repair
nodes.note: Uncommitted. Metadata prefix only; appendix and full writes not atomic; no compact/fsck.

nodes.label: Appendix + hash-chain lineage
nodes.note: Linear chain, rollback. No signatures/branching/merging. Engine ignores appendix records.

nodes.label: Platform / mmap
nodes.note: POSIX mmap done; Windows mapping unrun; no huge pages / NUMA / madvise.

nodes.label: Quantization formats (26)
nodes.note: Decoder + vecdot + batch kernel for each; reference-tested. DQ*/NF4 are storage + Python only.

nodes.label: Sparse storage (2:4, bitmask, CSR, BSR)
nodes.note: Reader decodes to f32; no sparse kernels in the engine.

nodes.label: NF4 / DQ dual-mode quantization
nodes.note: Quantize/dequantize pairs; no runtime residual policy; engine refuses.

nodes.label: CPU inference engine
nodes.note: Dense decoder, GQA, RMSNorm, gated MLP; Arch enum has 3 values. Weights are views of the mapped file.

nodes.label: ISA-dispatched kernels (engine stack)
nodes.note: x86: avx512/avx2vnni/avx2/generic. ARM: dotprod/neon (never run on ARM).

nodes.label: Legacy kernels (C ABI / Python stack)
nodes.note: Holds v1.1.0 gemmF32 zero-skip, RoPE table, FP8 LUT. Not used by the engine.

nodes.label: KV cache (segmented f16)
nodes.note: 256-position segments, tiled keys. No paging/quant/compression/eviction.

nodes.label: Sampler
nodes.note: greedy/temp/top-k/top-p/min-p/penalties/logit-bias. No typical/mirostat/custom/GPU.

nodes.label: Tokenizer + chat templates
nodes.note: BPE + SentencePiece; Jinja subset; checked vs llama.cpp on 301,948 tokens.

nodes.label: Vulkan backend
nodes.note: Whole model on one device; one NVIDIA card tested; slower than llama.cpp Vulkan; no coop matrices.

nodes.label: CUDA (standalone, not in engine)
nodes.note: Driver-API wrapper + embedded PTX; only bench and its own tests use it.

nodes.label: OpenAI-compatible server
nodes.note: chat/completions, completions, models, health, metrics, SSE, API key, slots. No embeddings/rerank/WebSocket/HTTP2/rate limits.

nodes.label: Library root + C ABI (libhk)
nodes.note: ~133 exports; no ABI version / struct-size / capability discovery.

nodes.label: Hub downloader (hk pull)
nodes.note: Resume, retries, SHA-256; GGUF + sharded safetensors. No split-GGUF, parallel, S3, registry.

nodes.label: Streaming converters
nodes.note: GGUF/safetensors/HF → .hk streaming; .hk → safetensors/GGUF. BPE-only tokenizer.json import.

nodes.label: hk CLI
nodes.note: ~30 commands; missing quantize/compact/fsck/history/diff/merge/sign/profile/distributed.

nodes.label: Benchmarks (hk-compare, hk-kernels)
nodes.note: Reproducible vs llama.cpp only.

nodes.label: Language bindings
nodes.note: C, C++, Rust, Go, C#, Java, TypeScript tested. Kotlin/Swift/ObjC absent.

nodes.label: Python SDK
nodes.note: Native engine/tokenizer wrappers + torch integration. No DLPack; NativeHKTensor/Model/Trainer absent.

nodes.label: Python architecture registry (169 aliases / 79 names)
nodes.note: Conversion/tensor-name mapping only. NOT engine support.

nodes.label: CI
nodes.note: Zig tests on 3 OSes, forced-ISA runs, cross-compile matrix, Python matrix, bindings. No GPU/ARM/mobile hardware.

nodes.label: User wiki
nodes.note: Rewritten in 1.1.1 against the code; auto-synced to GitHub wiki.

nodes.label: Net2Net growth
nodes.note: Wider SwiGLU/linear + vocab; deeper only in Python (linear). Small-model tests.

nodes.label: Pruning
nodes.note: Magnitude, Wanda, structured L2, block, 2:4, recovery fine-tune.

nodes.label: HKTrainer / LoRA / QLoRA
nodes.note: PyTorch-based; no native/distributed trainer; engine can't apply adapters.

nodes.label: Self-training / self-conversation / SPIN
nodes.note: Components, not a validated loop. No demonstrated improvement.

nodes.label: Code sandboxes
nodes.note: PLAN VIOLATION: Docker mode silently degrades to unsandboxed subprocess; Zig NativeSandbox does not enforce its timeout and is unused.

nodes.label: Backend abstraction (Backend interface)
nodes.note: Gate for CUDA/Metal/ROCm. engine/model.zig calls the Vulkan engine directly today.

nodes.label: Graph runtime / HK IR / fusion / liveness
nodes.note: Forward pass is hand-written; fusion is manual. No zgc code exists despite a commit message.

nodes.label: Unified memory planner + partial offload
nodes.note: Python offload.py is a torch-based planner only.

nodes.label: Metal backend
nodes.note: Needs Apple hardware.

nodes.label: Android / iOS runtime + SDKs
nodes.note: Java JNI glue exists but is not an Android package.

nodes.label: ArchitectureDescriptor/Parser/Validator/Executor
nodes.note: Replaces the 3-value Arch enum; needed for Gemma/Phi/MoE/SSM.

nodes.label: Continuous batching + paged KV + prefix cache
nodes.note: Slot scheduler and shared prompt cache exist.

nodes.label: Dual-mode quant runtime + auto mixed precision
nodes.note: `hk quantize` does not exist.

nodes.label: hk profile + autotuning + persistent kernel cache
Fuzzing + malicious-file corpus
nodes.note: Only Zig's scaffold fuzz example exists.

nodes.label: Plugin / extension system + stable ABI v1
Memory efficiency is the product
nodes.note: Stream, mmap, bounded buffers, measure peak RSS, flag O(model) paths. Owner rule.

nodes.label: Robustness: no silent failure; tests must bite
nodes.note: Flag or blank instead of guessing; mutation-check guards; state limits honestly. Owner rule.

nodes.label: Docs state only what was run
nodes.note: 1.1.1 removed overstated claims; do not reintroduce.

nodes.label: No 'faster' without a benchmark
nodes.note: Plan §1.5.

nodes.label: Quality > correctness > memory/IO > compute > accel > distributed > research
Zig 0.16 (std.Io), per-ISA kernel builds
nodes.note: minimum_zig_version 0.16.0.

nodes.label: Test suites
nodes.note: Zig unit/e2e suites, pytest, bindings runner. Reference tests: gguf package (quant decoders), HF Transformers (logits), llama.cpp (perplexity, tokenizer). No MMLU/code/math/long-context suites; no fuzzing.

nodes.label: Dev tools (generators, probes, HF Space app)
nodes.note: Quant fixture/table and Unicode table generators, hk-probe, SPIR-V extraction helper, HF Space demo.

edges.note: Independent code path; shares nothing at runtime.
Whole-file re-hash per mutation is O(file) time; open decision in HANDOFF.
Silent Docker->subprocess fallback violates this and plan §33.
